components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The shared filled action, with a deeper hover, no movement, visible focus, and the operational touch-size rule.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 36px; padding: 6px 11px; border: 1px solid var(--pos-primary, #25824f); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--pos-primary, #25824f); color: #fff; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 550; line-height: 1.45; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px #00000012; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, border-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-button-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--pos-hover, #1e6c41); border-color: var(--pos-hover, #1e6c41); transform: none; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--pos-primary, #25824f); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:disabled { opacity: .48; cursor: not-allowed; } @media (pointer: coarse), (max-width: 900px) { .ds-button-primary { min-height: 44px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button-primary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Labeled Text Field
components.description: A full-size label over a white field. Focus keeps the scoped border, inherits a soft halo, and adds the shared keyboard outline.

components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--ink, #262626); font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 450; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-field-input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; padding: 7px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e5e5e5); border-radius: 7px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink, #262626); font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 450; line-height: 1.45; caret-color: var(--pos-primary, #25824f); outline: 0; } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: #707070; opacity: 1; } .ds-field-input:hover { border-color: var(--line, #e5e5e5); } .ds-field-input:focus { border-color: var(--line, #e5e5e5); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(75,130,107,.12); } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--pos-primary, #25824f); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (pointer: coarse), (max-width: 900px) { .ds-field-input { min-height: 44px; } }

components.name: Shell Navigation
components.description: The sidebar link anatomy: outline icons, green active text without a filled capsule, and a gray hover wash. This sample does not implement routing or the mobile drawer.
components.html: InicioMenú

components.name: Section Tabs
components.description: The menu tab visual states: neutral underlines at rest and Selection Green for the active item. Selection changes remain the app's responsibility.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin: 0 0 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-y: hidden; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #e5e5e5); scrollbar-width: none; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-tab { position: relative; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #262626); font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 550; line-height: 1.45; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 3px; border-radius: 3px 3px 0 0; background: #d7d7d7; } .ds-tab-active::after { background: var(--pos-accent, #35a167); } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--ink, #262626); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--pos-primary, #25824f); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (max-width: 680px) { .ds-tab { flex: 0 0 auto; } } @media (max-width: 600px) { .ds-tabs { gap: 4px; } .ds-tab { padding-inline: 8px; font-size: 14px; } }

components.name: Settings Navigation
components.description: The local settings-navigation variant retains a pale green active fill and regular inactive labels. The full app replaces this list with a select at 900px.
components.html: <nav class="ds-settings-nav" aria-label="Secciones de configuración"><button class="ds-settings-nav-item ds-settings-nav-active" type="button" aria-current="page">General</button><button class="ds-settings-nav-item" type="button">Datos de sucursal</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-settings-nav { padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #dfe4e1; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; box-shadow: none; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-settings-nav-item { width: 100%; min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 10px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; color: #323a36; background: transparent; text-align: left; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 450; line-height: 1.45; cursor: pointer; } .ds-settings-nav-item:hover { color: #177d54; background: #f3f8f5; } .ds-settings-nav-item.ds-settings-nav-active { background: #eaf6ef; color: var(--pos-primary, #25824f); font-weight: 550; } .ds-settings-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--pos-primary, #25824f); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
Escalar AI POS uses a quiet, compact working surface: a light gray canvas, white containers, fine dividers, and green cues that direct attention without recoloring the entire workspace. The Maspedidos reference informs the operational density and familiar controls; the visible identity remains Escalar AI POS.

This document describes the implemented authenticated interface inside body.pos-operational, including body-mounted dialog portals. It is not a redesign proposal or a visual contract for login and the public menu, which retain their separate incumbent presentation. Shared primitives are consistent, while tables, kitchen cards, and split editors retain their own useful structures.
keyCharacteristics: Self-hosted Inter, readable body copy, and compact section headings.
White bordered surfaces on a neutral gray workspace.
Distinct green roles for primary actions and selection.
Compact desktop controls with enlarged mobile and coarse-pointer targets.
Persistent context, understated outline icons, and contextual editors.

rules.name: Two Greens
rules.body: Use Primary Green for filled white-text actions and keyboard outlines; use Selection Green for tab indicators and the implemented selection accents. They are distinct tokens, not interchangeable aliases.

rules.name: Reading Scale
rules.body: Keep the operational body and form labels at the body scale. Use the headline scale for the aligned workspace titles; preserve smaller metadata as a secondary layer rather than shrinking the entire interface.

rules.name: Surface Before Shadow
rules.body: Use white fill and a fine boundary to establish ordinary containers. Keep stronger shadows local to overlays and floating controls rather than applying them to every card.

dos: Do keep this system scoped to the authenticated operational body, including its dialog portals.
Do retain the Escalar AI POS name and existing identity assets.
Do use Primary Green for primary buttons and Selection Green for the established selection cues.
Do preserve the readable body scale, compact headings, and enlarged mobile/coarse-pointer controls.
Do retain visible focus, written status labels, and the existing dialog focus behavior.
Do reuse the appropriate list, kitchen-card, or editor structure instead of forcing every module into an identical layout.
donts: Don't restyle login or the public menu with the operational tokens.
Don't import Maspedidos branding, marketing copy, or unsupported controls.
Don't replace the neutral operational canvas with decorative gradients or a dark sidebar.
Don't add large entrance effects or uniform raised-card styling to the aligned workspace.
Don't treat component-specific legacy values as a new global palette or silently normalize them while following this document.
Don't treat the synthesized tonal ramps in the sidecar as implemented application tokens.
